threads.body: After suspension, `_ModelStreamWrapper.__del__()` still finalizes outside `_execution_context()`, so instrumented completion-hook work can become a child of the caller's span instead of `chat` when an unfinished stream is garbage-collected. Wrap `_finalize_success()` in the execution context, preserving the existing success-finalization behavior. Apply the same change to the agent stream destructor at `patch.py:440` so its completion hook runs under `invoke_agent`.

threads.body: This suspension relies on the base stream wrapper reactivating the invocation during reads, but that behavior was introduced in util-genai 1.3b0 (see its CHANGELOG.md, “Changed”). This package still allows util-genai >=1.2b0, so a supported installation can now run the model generator with the chat invocation suspended throughout, losing its execution context and child-span parenting. Raise the util-genai minimum to >=1.3b0 in the same PR.

This covers the caller side, but nothing checks that `chat` is still current while the model generator runs (the agent test has `_SpanningCodeModel` for that). Something like this would catch a regression in the per-read activation:

```python
def test_generate_stream_reads_under_the_chat_span(
    instrument_with_content, span_exporter
) -> None:
    model = transformers_model()
    seen = []

    def chunks():
        for text in ["In ", "Paris"]:
            seen.append(get_current_span().get_span_context().span_id)
            yield text

    model.streamer = chunks()
    list(model.generate_stream(messages=MESSAGES))

    (chat,) = spans_by_operation(span_exporter.get_finished_spans(), "chat")
    assert seen == [chat.context.span_id] * 2
```
